description: Submits an event to a town's calendar. The compliance screen runs inside this call: an approved paid submission comes back with a hosted payment URL, a rejected one comes back with a reason and no charge was ever possible. CHARGES NOTHING — a person must open the URL and enter card details. Nothing published here publishes itself: a paid listing goes live only after payment is confirmed, a free (`standard`) one only after a person approves it. Call get_listing_prices first.

buyerEmail.description: Where the receipt and the payment link go. Must be a real address, not a disposable one. An accepted submission also subscribes this address to the town's daily email (one-click unsubscribe in every issue) — tell the person.

category.description: One of the town calendar's categories, e.g. "Music", "Markets", "Family".

description.description: What it is, in a sentence or two.

endsAt.description: Last day, for a multi-day event.

startTime.description: Local start time as HH:MM, 24-hour. Omit for an all-day event.

startsAt.description: Event date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or later.

tier.description: standard = free review queue; listing and featured are paid and return a payment link.

url.description: Link to tickets, RSVP, or details. Required.

name: create_event_listing
title: List an event in a town (returns a payment link)
